steps.content: Finally, Isomer claims the position of Chief Scientist. With all authority gathered in her hands, her takeover of the Observation Hub is complete.
The once-lively control room is now empty.
The lights are off. In the darkness, the comms device suddenly lights up, the brightness blindingly harsh. It's that encrypted channel again.

<color=#fb9259>[Data Encrypted]</color>: Has the handover been completed? We still have time, but she wants you back on the experiments as soon as possible. The old project is still valuable and should not be delayed.
<color=#fb9259>[Data Encrypted]</color>: A new batch of researchers will arrive shortly. I trust you to make effective use of them.

<color=#A5E3FB>[Reply]</color>: I will. But we're short-handed. I need to keep my current team.
<color=#fb9259>[Data Encrypted]</color>: There will be plenty of new ones for you to choose from.

<color=#A5E3FB>[Reply]</color>: I prefer the ones I'm already used to using.
<color=#A5E3FB>[Reply]</color>: We already succeeded in undermining her. There's no need to worry about her getting carried away over the project's success. The moment we shattered the pride of that "genius," we broke her.
<color=#A5E3FB>[Reply]</color>: I need the best minds to shorten the transition.
<color=#fb9259>[Data Encrypted]:</color><color=#3370FF>...Think carefully about what truly counts as an achievement, Isomer. Don't make the same mistake.</color>
After a long moment of silence, the other side finally continues.

<color=#fb9259>[Data Encrypted]</color>: Remember the timeline. It won't be long. The critical item has yet to be verified. We've entrusted the final phase to you, and we await your feedback... This is crucial.

<color=#fb9259>[Data Encrypted]</color>: Use your rational judgment, Isomer. If you do a good job, she promises to nominate you for the seat.
The messages stop, and all records are automatically destroyed. Isomer clutches the device, her grip tightening. Before she loses control...
Fortunately, another notification tone grabs her attention.

Multiple surveillance cameras line the corridors leading here, and every feed shows the same image: a gray figure forcing their way through layers of guards and checkpoints almost violently, and then...
Bang! A crash against the door. Alarms blare, followed by the beeps of electronic locks being breached. The control room door swings open, and the visitor appears before Isomer.
Seeing his furious expression, something inside Isomer eases unexpectedly. She smiles.
steps.female_content: Seeing her furious expression, something inside Isomer eases unexpectedly. She smiles.

steps.content: You fix her with a piercing glare. The woman remains every bit as cold and composed as she was the first time you met. What infuriates you even more is that she has achieved exactly what she set out to do. Now she wears a smug expression, as though she's about to invite you to share the spoils of her victory.
And you're no longer a collaborator in her scheme. She defeated you. You've lost your true companions, and you're consumed with anger.
